# V2 static-to-live contract and ownership matrix (dinodia.v1)

All identifiers are opaque strings. Every household request, cache key, route, token and offline grant is bound to both `homeId` and `homeMembershipId`; current membership/area/device authority is re-evaluated by the source, not inferred from a cached DTO. Customer accounts are distinct from Company Portal employee identities. No public DTO contains HA entity/domain/service IDs, integration execution bindings, database keys, credentials or private tenant-device details.

| Surface/data | Canonical contract / authority | Read/write path and permission | Freshness/offline and empty/error behavior | Stage owner / forbidden fallback |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Existing customer sign-in and membership chooser; account creation/recovery remain later | Customer session + membership list; employee login remains Portal-only; sign-in registers the stable device-protected trusted-phone identity | `POST /api/v2/auth/session`, `GET /api/v2/session`, then explicit `POST /api/v2/hub-sessions`; verified customer only | HttpOnly session cookie remains in URLSession; account receipt contains no bearer; empty membership list stays empty; only an explicitly selected or revalidated remembered active membership issues a hub session | Stage 2 iOS provider/root for existing-customer sign-in and account-global selection; account creation/recovery remain Stage 3; no static identity/home/dashboard fallback |
| Offline property chooser | `offlineHomeSelection`; exact account/home/membership/trusted-device grant and area scope | only locally verified, previously enrolled authority; exact-home signed LAN challenge required before selection | expired, revoked, mismatched or absent grant is not selectable; no online membership is synthesized offline | Stage 2 fixture/rendered shell; durable offline authority remains Stage 4; no cached-membership-only selection |
| Home context, role, access policy | HomeMembership and TenantAreaGrant | `/api/v2/homes/{homeId}/context`, `/access-policy`; selected membership | revisioned; stale access blocks writes | Stage 3; no global ADMIN/TENANT authority |
| Area, overrides, grouping, floorplan | canonical area IDs, explicit overrideName and preference geometry | `/overrides`, `/preferences`; owner/manager edit, tenant sees authorized areas | revision conflict rejects save; empty area is valid | Stages 3/8; no label-derived grouping authority |
| Tenant devices, filters, tiles, controls | NativeDevice + dynamic descriptor + control-state; `managementClass` immutable | `/tenant/devices/*`; current membership/area; tenant-device owner only | descriptor revision gates commands; stale state becomes unknown; hub outage disables controls | Stages 4/5; no static sample or HA public fallback |
| Bounded wire strings | JSON Schema `maxLength`; opaque IDs, Area/device/control labels, units, option labels, text values and idempotency keys | Canonical dinodia.v1 validators in Platform, OS, Swift and Alexa | All `maxLength`/`minLength` values count Unicode code points; UTF-16 units and grapheme clusters are not wire units | Stage 2 contract; `fixtures/bounded-string-unicode-semantics.json` |
| Owner/manager inventory and information | cloud inventory projection and heartbeat only | home context/inventory; no direct local control | cached cloud tiles + last updated; no live claim on stale data | Stages 4/5; no owner direct OS transport |
| Commissioning Zigbee/Matter | commissioning DTO and OS-owned capability descriptors | authenticated tenant commissioning flow, authorized home | interrupted/expired is recoverable; unsupported explicit | Stage 5; no HA service IDs in contract |
| Automations | one native automation family; control IDs + descriptor revisions | automation API, tenant edits own, owner/manager oversight | invalidated when descriptor/access changes; explicit execution state | Stage 6; no label/name inference, no security controls |
| Alexa | one Alexa connection family, selected tenant memberships and area subsets | Alexa adapter; tenant only | revocation prunes areas; locks/security omitted | Stage 7; no HA entity IDs, no owner Alexa |
| Analytics | actual activity observations, validUntil, Unknown; hourly counters | Platform/Supabase projections; property scope only | stale/missing/offline => Unknown; yearly/monthly/weekly/daily average device samples; hourly sums selected devices; summary averages visible buckets | Stage 10; no kWh/cost/gas-volume relabeling |
| Support, ticket, access request/session/code exchange | Stage 1 support authorities; ticket IDs/revisions; every home-scoped ticket carries both `homeId` and `homeMembershipId` (both null only for account-only cases) | customer/employee route families, role-filtered; approved code exchange only | close revokes immediately; hub acknowledgement may remain pending | Stage 9; no emergency override or ticket-as-account authority |
| Alerts, activity, Trusted Devices | notification policy and audit/activity DTOs | `/notifications/*`, `/activity`, `/trusted-devices/*` | deduplicated delivery receipts; security events mandatory | Stages 3/9; no inbox/SMS/rename device fields |
| Hub health and maintenance | signed 120s heartbeat; online through 420s | Vercel ingestion, Supabase projection | offline after 420s; next valid signed heartbeat restores; Last Online = accepted timestamp | Stages 4/5; no AWS backend |
| Operations and schedules | Fixed seven-task Stage 2 allocation in `decisions.json`; two dispatchers only. The four-entry `nativeTaskRegistry` is the currently executable Stage 1 subset, not a competing Stage 2 allocation. | `/api/cron/native-operations`, `/api/cron/native-maintenance`; signed heartbeat and domain writes remain primary paths | per-task lease/checkpoint, bounded timeout/batch and independent failure result; request/event paths do primary work; scheduled work is recovery/qualification only | Platform; Edge has no schedule; future-stage tasks are contract allocations only and must not be activated before their owning stage |
| API errors and UI states | `error.schema.json`; stable `error.code`, requestId; finite UIState union | all Native V2 routes and clients | restoring_session/loading/ready/empty/stale/offline/denied/expired/uncertain/maintenance/error | all consumers; no silent retry to old stack |
| Identity and distribution | customer global principal + membership authority; app name Dinodia Smart Living | iOS V2 bundle/Keychain/APNs separate from old app | no import/session reuse/deep-link auth from old app | iOS; `V2` internal only |

## Screen, field, action and state register

The keys below are stable contract keys, not database IDs. A screen must not render a household surface until the selected active `homeMembershipId` is resolved. Stage ownership names the later feature stage; Stage 2 freezes its shape and does not implement persistence or the feature itself. `validUntil` and current authority always win over cached presentation. Every final-column fixture path is exact, exists in the canonical fixture directory, and is executed by `scripts/check_dinodia_contracts.mjs` according to the indexed schema or semantic expectation.

All HTTP writes use an expected resource revision and a 24-hour mutation idempotency key unless the route is explicitly read-only. Events are ordered per `(homeId, streamId, sequence)`; duplicate or older sequence is ignored. A command timeout is `uncertain`, and the client queries its receipt before a retry. These shared rules do not create the Stage 3 feature routes or persistence.

### Fixed native task registry

| Task ID | Sole owner | Cadence | Bounded responsibility |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `operator_credential_lifecycle` | Supabase `pg_cron` → `pg_net` → Vercel `native-operations` | 2 minutes | Reconcile due operator credential transitions/rotation. |
| `support_expiry_and_revocation` | Supabase `pg_cron` → `pg_net` → Vercel `native-operations` | 2 minutes | Expire support requests/sessions and persist desired hub revocation. |
| `claim_reservation_expiry` | Supabase `pg_cron` → `pg_net` → Vercel `native-operations` | 2 minutes | Release expired first-wins claim reservations. |
| `expired_dispatch_lease_cleanup` | Vercel Hobby `native-maintenance` | Daily, 03:00 UTC | Delete only expired `native-operations-lease` rows; business idempotency records are not touched. |

There is exactly one Supabase two-minute schedule, one Vercel daily schedule and zero Edge schedules. `native-operations` and `native-maintenance` execute disjoint task IDs; the daily maintenance route must never rerun operational business tasks.

### Fixed task ownership and activation boundary

`stage2TaskAllocation` freezes all seven semantic task IDs and one dispatcher owner without activating later-stage feature behavior. Stage ownership is explicit: `credentialLifecycle` (Stage 1); `deliveryAndEnforcement`, `retentionCleanup`, and `expiryAndOrphanCleanup` (Stage 3); `healthAndIncidentQualification` (Stage 4); `alexaProactiveDelivery` (Stage 7); and `analyticsAndStorageMaintenance` (Stage 10). The current `nativeTaskRegistry` is the executable Stage 1 subset only: credential lifecycle, support/claim expiry and dispatcher-lease cleanup. It must not be expanded with later-stage handlers in this contract cycle. The exact, machine-checked fixture references for every stable screen/action and active task are in `fixtures/index.json`; missing paths or extra/unregistered keys fail `check_dinodia_contracts.mjs`. The checker validates both task registries independently so a future task allocation cannot create a second schedule or silently become executable early.

## Global transport and semantic rules

- `dinodia.v1` uses RFC3339 UTC times, monotonically increasing home/catalog revisions, tombstones for deletion, and idempotency keys for commands. Out-of-order/duplicate events are ignored by `(homeId, streamId, sequence)` and do not roll state backward.
- Tenant device DTO visibility is an authorization decision: include only when `ownerMembershipId == selected homeMembershipId`; labels never establish ownership. Owner/manager projections omit tenant devices entirely.
- `manual_app_only` security controls may be manually invoked by an authorized app with operation-bound step-up; automation and Alexa adapters must reject them.
- Control support derives only from current typed descriptor metadata. Customer labels, display names, device type guesses and protocols cannot manufacture controls or analytics activity.
- Light activity is power on OR brightness > 0; radiator activity is active heat demand; boiler activity is actual heat production. Unknown telemetry or expired validity => `activity=unknown`; target temperature/mode is not activity.
- Homeowner analytics use the checked-in V2 aggregation: yearly/monthly/weekly/daily averages over contributing device samples; hourly drill-down sums currently selected devices; summary averages displayed buckets. Units are minutes on/off/unknown and radiator temperature only.
- Edge is a canonical Vercel ingress proxy, never an API/data authority. Supabase alone owns persistence; OS owns direct tenant live state/control and signed heartbeat production; Platform validates, authorizes and writes projections.
